scope.text: word/document.xml paragraphs, including table cells; notes, comments and layout excluded
scope.dialogue: numbered main-mission dialogue only; side-quest and unnumbered dialogue excluded
scope.repetition: identical normalized speaker/text within one mission; editorial review, not an automatic defect
scope.age: calendar-year comparison to campaign start; exact birthdays and open-ended dates are not inferred
scope.privacy: no dialogue/full-text export; only hashes, IDs, markers and paragraph locations
